mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressure, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 indicates weakening real economic activity and falling corporate earnings growth, which reduces equity risk appetite and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 104.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential investment signals strong aggregate demand and rising inflation expectations, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction term Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 319.5 combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 319.5 and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction term Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payroll growth signals a labor market overheating that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, or the interaction term Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures combined with rising residential investment signals strong aggregate demand and a late-cycle expansion, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to elevated earnings growth and risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction term Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
